projects.name: tutty
projects.description: Tutty Studio allows you to automatize tutorial and product showcase videos either fully autonomous using AI or manual or semi-manual, one stop solution for any video creation! 16:9 landscape or portrait? Everything is versioned plus it provides Windows native Clicker Telemetry so you can make multiple shots in one run and Tutty Studio will split it and you can set purpose of each split take, for example Product Showcase, Outcome, Step By Step, How We Did It. projects.name: nai-browser
projects.description: NAI Browser — our fork of BrowserOS classic (the people-facing browser), where Thorium CPU instruction optimizations are harvested. Distinct from BrowserOS neo (the agent browser). More than a browser: it is a native platform — patched Chromium (chromium_patches/components/nai_rt_core/src/d3d12) carries a real D3D12 RAY-TRACING pipeline (shaders/raytracing_dxil.h), and it embeds a full local LLM inference server (BeelLama llama.cpp, CUDA+Vulkan) as a supervised naiInference backend (resources/binaries/beellama/llama-server.exe, port 8123) wired into Assistant/Agent/Chat. Native GPU ray-tracing + a bundled local-model server inside a browser = an app OS platform wearing a browser's skin.
projects.deployTarget: NAI Browser binary; bundles BeelLama at resources/binaries/beellama/llama-server.exe (port 8123, naiInference backend)

projects.deployTarget: NAI Inference engine; bundled into NAI Browser as resources/binaries/beellama/llama-server.exe (port 8123)

projects.name: kilo-gastown
projects.description: Gas Town — Kilo Org's dashboard agentic control plane, forked on the pre-strip commit (last week Kilo Org removed features behind their paid Kilo Cloud / Cloudflare Workers / kilo gateway). We forked it before the stripping and added a full LOCAL-ONLY control plane with support for ANY provider, plus custom tweaks. It lets multiple agents (like you here in chat) communicate in a mesh/hedron agent network, so the human only solves critical stuff and agents work autonomously — backed by a review agent + a NAI Inquisitor agent (gives a score; delivery is NOT finished until the score is 10/10). Still in development. Custom integration lives in NAI-Lattice (lattice-gastown). IMPORTANT: the Qdrant collection was indexed by Kilo under the exact path C:\src\kilo-gastown-local (backslashes, C:\ — NOT the forward-slash form git reports as C:/src/kilo-gastown-local, which hashes to a different, empty collection).
projects.buildCommand: pnpm install && turbo build (Kilo Org fork)
projects.runCommand: local Gas Town dashboard / control plane + agents
projects.deployTarget: Local control plane for the NAI agent mesh (NAI-Inquisitor review gate; 10/10 required)
